clue.text: Licensed carrier

parts.note: a vehicle that needs a road licence and carries passengers, rather than a licensed haulier or airline

explanation.surface: Sounds like an officially authorised airline or delivery firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Licensed' suggests a business permit, but a private vehicle needs a road tax licence and carries people.
explanation.definitionFit: An automobile must be taxed and licensed for the road, and it carries people and goods.

clue.text: They admit they don't have to pay the rent

definitions.text: They admit they don't have to pay the rent

parts.words: They admit they don't have to pay the rent
parts.note: people who possess their homes outright pay no landlord; 'admit' plays on confessing versus letting people in

explanation.surface: A group confessing that they are exempt from paying rent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Admit' reads as confess, but proprietors also admit visitors to the property they hold.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who hold the title to a property pay no rent on it, since there is no landlord above them.

clue.text: Beginning working as a film actor

definitions.meaning: a film actor at work is on the set, read as two words

explanation.surface: Someone starting a career in the movies.
explanation.definitionFit: A start is the onset of something; split in two, the word describes being at work on a film set.

clue.text: NCO translated letters for soldier

indicators.note: translated means the letters of NCO are rendered into a new form, rearranged

parts.note: script is handwriting, written letters

explanation.surface: A non-commissioned officer deciphers correspondence for a private.
explanation.definitionFit: A draftee is a soldier called up compulsorily for military service.

clue.text: Disconcerted to be told secrets about a number

indicators.note: about means the informing word goes around the number

parts.note: to rat is to inform, to betray secrets
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone shaken at having their secrets exposed about a figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Being flustered or unnerved is a synonym of being disconcerted.

clue.text: Support delay

definitions.meaning: to prop up or bear the weight of

explanation.surface: Backing for a postponement.
explanation.definitionFit: As a phrasal verb it means to prop up; as a noun it means a traffic stoppage or wait.

clue.text: Drenched with water so he'd have to change

indicators.note: have to change means the letters of the preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A soaked man has to change his clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprayed from a garden pipe, so thoroughly soaked.

clue.text: It's clear to me, anyway, one will miss deadline

indicators.note: anyway means in any manner, the letters taken in any order

explanation.surface: Someone declaring that it is obvious to them anyway.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who arrives after the appointed time misses the deadline.

clue.text: Courtesy, a quality of the townsman?

definitions.meaning: playfully, the quality of being a city dweller

explanation.surface: Politeness as a trait of city folk.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means refined courtesy, and whimsically the state of belonging to a city.

clue.text: Trade organisation getting round start of strike agreement

indicators.note: getting round means the organisation's word surrounds the next letter

parts.note: a trade union is an organisation of workers

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of strike is taken

explanation.surface: A labour union agrees to begin industrial action.
explanation.walkthrough: UNISON is also a real British public-sector union, adding to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting together in complete accord is acting in harmony or agreement.

clue.text: Trial with underground lab equipment

parts.note: a trial is a test
the Tube is London's underground railway

explanation.surface: Testing new kit on a subway system.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tube is the London Underground.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass cylinder closed at one end is standard laboratory glassware.

clue.text: Finding fault may be crucial

explanation.surface: Fault-finding might be vitally important.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means censorious and also means of decisive importance.

clue.text: Taking a chance, cutting up vegetables

definitions.meaning: gambling with dice, or risking danger

explanation.surface: A cook gambling while chopping produce.
explanation.definitionFit: Dicing with death is taking risks, and cooks cube carrots by this method.

clue.text: He is constructively employed in a supporting role

definitions.text: He is constructively employed in a supporting role

parts.words: He is constructively employed in a supporting role
parts.note: 'constructively' means on a building site, and the supporting role is assistant to a bricklayer

explanation.surface: A helpful assistant doing useful work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constructively' means usefully, but here it is literal: he works in construction as a labourer's helper.
explanation.definitionFit: A labourer who assists a tradesman on a construction site has a supporting job.

clue.text: Curiosities from barbaric organisation going over century

indicators.note: going over means the reworked letters go on top of the next piece in this down entry
organisation means the letters of barbaric are arranged anew

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Odd objects come from an uncivilised group taking over a hundred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' rearranges BARBARIC into BRICABRA; in a down clue 'going over' puts it above C.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornaments and knick-knacks of small value are curios collected for display.

clue.text: Trial from which the public is excluded

definitions.text: Trial from which the public is excluded

parts.words: Trial from which the public is excluded
parts.note: a practice run before an audience is admitted, not a court case in camera

explanation.surface: A court hearing held behind closed doors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trial' suggests a court case, but it is a try-out of a play before opening night.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice performance is held before the audience is admitted.

clue.text: A combination of factors

parts.note: in arithmetic, multiplying factors together produces this kind of number

explanation.surface: Several causes coming together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'factors' suggests causes, but in mathematics a product of factors is such a number.
explanation.definitionFit: A number like twelve results from multiplying factors such as three and four.

clue.text: One whose pupils are encouraged to make notes

definitions.text: One whose pupils are encouraged to make notes

parts.words: One whose pupils are encouraged to make notes
parts.note: the notes are musical ones played or sung, not written jottings

explanation.surface: A teacher urging students to write things down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make notes' suggests jotting in class; here the notes are musical sounds.
explanation.definitionFit: An instructor of piano or singing has students producing musical sounds.

clue.text: She plays with electricity switch

parts.note: AC is alternating current
a switch is a long lock or tress of hair

explanation.surface: A girl playing with a light switch.
explanation.walkthrough: A switch is a tress of hair, often false, besides an electrical control.
explanation.definitionFit: A female performer plays roles on stage or screen.

clue.text: Discontent in a French vacation

parts.note: un is French for a
a holiday is a rest

explanation.surface: Unhappiness on a holiday in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitation and dissatisfaction among people amount to discontent.

clue.text: Bear right to enter London thoroughfare

indicators.note: to enter means the letter goes inside the word for bear

parts.note: to bear is to stand, tolerate

explanation.surface: Directions for a driver turning into a London street.
explanation.walkthrough: The Strand is a famous street in central London.
explanation.definitionFit: The Strand is a major street in the West End of the capital.

clue.text: See fit to listen to Hamlet, for example?

indicators.note: to listen to means the word is heard, not seen

parts.note: Hamlet was Prince of Denmark, a Dane

explanation.surface: Deciding whether to attend a performance of Shakespeare.
explanation.definitionFit: To condescend or see fit to do something is the verb's meaning.

clue.text: Giving instruction to change it, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Telling someone to alter something, regrettably.
explanation.definitionFit: Instructing pupils is the act of educating them.

clue.text: Such a vocation is a source of ruin

indicators.note: is a source of means the letters come out of the phrase before it

explanation.surface: A certain career brings ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: Widespread destruction and devastation is ruin.

clue.text: A couple of pence increase in value

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for penny or pence, twice
to raise is to increase

explanation.surface: A tiny rise in price of two pennies.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess or estimate the worth of something is to value it.

clue.text: Veto is coming from old Russian council

indicators.note: coming from means the result emerges out of the letters of the words before, rearranged

explanation.surface: A veto issued by a Russian assembly of the past.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers' councils in revolutionary Russia were the original elected assemblies of that name.

clue.text: Highlight of historic communication

definitions.meaning: a light placed on a high point, read literally
fires lit on hills once sent warnings across the country

explanation.surface: The best moment of an old message.
explanation.definitionFit: A signal fire on a hilltop is a light set high, and such fires once relayed news.

clue.text: Requests are allowable in distress-signal

indicators.note: in means the permitted word sits inside the distress call

parts.note: SOS is the Morse distress call
licit means lawful, permitted

explanation.surface: Pleas for help are permitted in an emergency call.
explanation.definitionFit: To ask earnestly for something is to petition or request it.
